name: completed_orders_only_for_revenue
rule: When calculating gross revenue, total sales, or customer purchase totals, only consider orders with status = 'completed'.

name: active_customers_filter
rule: When generating queries about current or eligible customers, exclude inactive and suspended accounts (status = 'active').

name: successful_payments_filter
rule: Only payments with status = 'successful' count towards settled or reconciled cash collections.

name: available_inventory_definition
rule: An item is considered available for sale only when is_active = 1 and stock_quantity > 0.

name: order_item_line_total
rule: The net line-item revenue for an order item is computed as (quantity * unit_price) - discount.
